description_en: Queries media by using OSS file URLs
description_zh: 使用OSS文件地址查询媒体
name: QueryMediaListByURL

parameters.help_en:
The URLs of the media files to be queried. You can log on to the MPS console, choose Media management > Media list to find the media files to be queried, click Manage in the Actions column, and obtain the media file URLs on the Obtain transcoding URL tab. Separate multiple URLs with commas (,). You can query up to 10 URLs at a time.
The URL must comply with RFC 3986. It must be UTF-8 encoded and URL-encoded for reserved characters. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html. The URL cannot exceed 3,200 bytes in length.

Only OSS HTTP URLs are supported. CDN URLs and HTTPS URLs are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
需要查询的媒体文件地址，可以登录MPS控制台，通过媒体管理 > 媒体列表找到需要查询的媒体文件，单击操作列管理，在获取转码地址页签中获取媒体文件地址。用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多查询10个。
URL遵循RFC 3986（UTF8编码，并对保留字符进行URLEncode。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/423796.html），不超过3200字节。

仅支持OSS HTTP地址，不支持CDN地址和HTTPS地址
parameters.name: file_urls

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the response includes playback information.

Valid values: true (included), false (not included).

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中是否包含播放信息。

取值范围：true（包含）、false（不包含）。

默认值：false
parameters.name: include_play_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the response includes snapshot information.
Valid values: true (included), false (not included).

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中是否包含截图信息。
取值范围：true（包含）、false（不包含）。

默认值：false
parameters.name: include_snapshot_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the response includes media information.
Valid values: true (included), false (not included).

Default value: false.

    > To obtain detailed media information, set this parameter to true
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中是否包含媒体信息。
取值范围：true（包含）、false（不包含）。

默认值：false。

    > 如需获取详细MediaInfo信息，请将本参数设置为true
parameters.name: include_media_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the response includes the summary list.
Valid values: true (yes), false (no).

Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
返回结果中是否包含摘要列表。
取值范围：true（是）、false（否）。

默认值：false
parameters.name: include_summary_list
